notes: After installing Engolo on T4 the Runner clicked for credits 4x every turn T5-T15 (ending on 42 credits with 5 unplayed cards) and never ran again, letting Corp score Send a Message (T7), Obokata (T10) and Obokata (T16) out of Server 3 untouched, including T9 and T15 when Server 3 ice had been derezzed by Divert Power. Repeated R&D runs T1-T2 on an unchanged top card were also wasted.

Won, but ran R&D into Ansel 1.0 about 14 times (T6-T19) with no working sentry break, losing Hippo, Black Orchestra (repeatedly), DJ Fenris, Liberated Account x2, MKUltra, Gachapon and Botulus, even though Ansel's third sub forbids stealing, so those runs could never score; MKUltra was installed from the heap mid-encounter and then never used to break. T3 Overclock into unrezzed HQ ice with no breakers wasted the event.

Ran Slot Machine on R&D 4x on T1 and 3x on T2 (same top card each time), bleeding to 0 credits, and never installed Paperclip/Black Orchestra held in grip. T5-T6 facechecked Border Control and Anansi with no breakers; after Anansi's 4 net damage on T6 it drew 2 and ran the same Anansi again, a foreseeable flatline.

Solid tempo (Sure Gamble, Street Peddler, Dirty Laundry, Yusuf) with remote steals T5/T6. On T7 at 6 points it spent its last click installing Daily Casts instead of running the brand-new naked Server 3 (which held Efficiency Committee, the winning steal it took on T8); Stimhack core damage was spent twice (T4, T7) just to trash cheap assets.

Good start (Send a Message steal T5) but then hoarded 20-40 credits running empty Archives T12-T17/T20/T22 and Diesel-drawing into discards; on T18-T19 it paid ~34 credits re-hosting Ika on Anansi over and over, then sold Endurance (T19) and Ika (T20) to Aesop's Pawnshop. It never ran Server 3 while three Obokata Protocols were installed and advanced (T19-T24), and never drew up the grip that stealing Obokata requires.

T1 played two Stimhacks to run an ICE-less R&D, taking 2 core damage (losing Imp, D4v1d) for nothing; it then sat on 1 credit for 16 turns without ever clicking for credits. After Yusuf counters ran out it ran Hagen on HQ and Server 6 about 30 times (T11-T17) with no way through while Corp scored Global Food Initiative twice from Server 6.

Competent MaxX game: strong economy, heap-installed MKUltra/Paperclip used correctly, remote steals T8/T12/T13. Minor: spent down to 0 credits on T8 into Hard-Hitting News and then spent T9-T11 clicks partially clearing tags while Corp trashed Aeneas Informant.

T1 Stimhack into unrezzed Server 1 ice (Thimblerig ETR) cost core damage for nothing; T2 it spent its last 4 credits removing IP Block tags and then sat at 0 credits for 13 turns. It ran IP Block (ETR if tagged) about 43 times T3-T14 while tagged and never clicked for credits, letting Corp score Nisei MK II twice and Obokata unopposed.

Ran an unchanged R&D top card 3-4 times every turn T1-T8 while stuck on 2 credits, losing Black Orchestra to Fairchild 3.0 on T4 and never replacing a breaker. Decisive error T13: it used Pinhole Threading on Server 4, paid 6 credits and core damage through Loki, and then swapped the access for an already-known Rashida instead of the 2-advanced Global Food Initiative that Corp scored next turn to win.

Repeatedly ran Ansel 1.0 on R&D (T9, T11, T12 x2, T15, T16 x2, T18), losing Black Orchestra, Fermenter, MKUltra x3, Gachapon and Hippo, with MKUltra heap-installed but never used to break; it also wasted Pinhole Threading on a known Mavirus (T4) and jacked out mid-run T9/T14 (Mad Dash wasted). At 6 points it ignored Server 2 (Magnet only, Corp broke) on T10-T12 and again on T20, where Corp then Seamless-Launched Luminal Transubstantiation for the win.

Reasonable multi-access pressure with Yusuf/Datasucker/Engolo and a Vacheron win, but it ran Archives on T12 and T16 knowing News Teams were there (taking 4 and 6 tags), then burned most clicks T13-T20 removing tags while Corp trashed Daily Casts every turn. Zer0 used every turn shredded the grip (Hippo, Keiko, Sure Gamble, Dirty Laundry); Stimhack core damage T16 just to trash Jeeves.

Fast, sensible HQ pressure with Sure Gamble, Inject and Liberated Account, winning on T6 with MKUltra heap-installed to break Anansi. The only oddity is using Street Peddler on T4 to install a redundant second Yusuf.

Never installed a card or ran a remote all game; it ran the ICE-less R&D four times every turn on an unchanged top card (T12 it re-accessed the same News Team 4 times for 8 tags) and ran Archives into known News Teams (T11, T15). Meanwhile Corp scored seven small agendas (Hyperloop, Future is Now, False Lead, Megaprix) from barely-iced Servers 1 and 5 that were never challenged; T1 Stimhack on an open R&D wasted core damage.

T1 Stimhack on an ICE-less R&D (core damage, lost Imp), then T2 spent all 6 credits removing 3 of 4 Hard-Hitting News tags and sat at 0 credits T2-T9 running the same R&D card 4x per turn while Corp scored Bellona twice. Once rich (T11-T14, 13-22 credits) it only clicked credits/draws, never ran or trashed the naked Commercial Bankers Group, Mumba Temple, Rashida and Jeeves remotes, and Black Orchestra was installed on T9 but never used.

Won with a good T10 Hippo+Paperclip run on Server 1 for Project Beale, but T2-T5 were idle clicking for credits at 9-14 credits with no runs, a second Imp was installed T6 while Imp's trash ability was never used (paid 3 to trash Marilyn instead), and T7 it facechecked Enigma on HQ without a decoder. Several empty Archives runs (T12, T14, T15) were wasted.

Won against a passive Corp, but T3-T11 were almost entirely repeated runs on the same unchanged R&D top card (only partly justified by Yusuf counters, which Cyberdex purged on T8) while sitting at 4 credits and never drawing or building economy. T1 Stimhack on an unprotected R&D took core damage for nothing.

Slow start (T2-T4 and T6 spent clicking for credits with nothing to spend them on). On T10 at 5 points it accessed Obokata Protocol with 4 cards in grip and declined, although taking 4 net damage would have survived and won the game on the spot; it also used Hippo on Thimblerig and then still paid Black Orchestra to break it, and lost Yusuf to Stimhack core damage.

Repeated R&D runs on the same top card T1-T2, then from T4 to T11 it clicked for credits nearly every click, reaching 41 credits with no plan. It never ran Server 2 while Global Food Initiative sat there T8-T11 (Gatekeeper is beatable by heap-installing Black Orchestra, milled T6) and never trashed Advanced Assembly Lines or Rashida, so Corp won T12.

Efficient aggressive game: early R&D steal T2, then repeated HQ runs through the non-ETR Architect for Vitruvius, GFI and Vitruvius, winning T5. D4v1d and Paperclip installed on T1 were never needed, leaving the Runner briefly broke, which is a minor inefficiency.

T1 Overclock on an ICE-less R&D wasted its credits; it then sat at 1 credit T1-T6 running the same R&D card 4x per turn, never playing Liberated Account/Daily Casts in grip or trashing the naked Marilyn, Commercial Bankers Group x2 and Spin Doctor remotes. After Hard-Hitting News (T5) it removed only 1 of 4 tags and was flatlined T7 by High-Profile Target, a foreseeable kill against a 23-credit Corp.
